author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Wildlife Reserves Features Trailer for Planet Zoo 2, the hit zoo simulation game developed by Frontier Developments. Players will set out to tend to the various Wildlife Reserves in the game, with the Sumatran Rainforest reserve taking center stage. Adjust the terrain, manage animal release groups, and conduct research across the reserve. Planet Zoo 2 is launching on October 13 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Xbox on PC, Steam, and Epic Games Store).
title: Planet Zoo 2 - Official Wildlife Reserves Features Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Hot off the heels of the 40th Anniversary Direct for The Legend of Zelda, Nintendo brings us a second Nintendo Direct for September 2026. Join IGN's NVC podcast crew for a live watch party  who will react to all the reveals in real time. Stick around for expert analysis on all the game news and updates. The Nintendo Direct begins on September 9th, 2026 at 7am PT | 10am ET.

#IGN #Gaming #Nintendo
title: Nintendo Direct Livestream & Watch Party (September 2026)

author: GameTrailers
description:
The time has come for two huge reveals on the Zelda front. The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake is poised to make its true debut in the Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary Direct. Expect looks at gameplay, cinematics, and how core systems of the game might change. In addtion, The Legend of Zelda live-action film is long overdue for an offical teaser or full on trailer. IGN's NVC crew will be right there along side you watching along and reacting to all the reveals. Stick arond after the Nintendo Direct ends for expert analysis on all the news. The Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary Direct begins on Septermber 8th, 2026 at 7am PT | 10am ET.

#IGN #Gaming #Nintendo
title: The Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary Nintendo Direct Livestream & Watch Party

author: GameTrailers
description:
Here's your look at the Send in the Clown announcement trailer for this upcoming bite-sized, comedy adventure game that sees players dive headfirst into the role of Pockets, history’s least-appreciated clown. 

In Send in the Clown, take control of Pockets The Clown, a birthday entertainer who must acquire a whole host of classic clown abilities to take back Miranda’s party from her brat brother who is trying to turn this party into a circus, and not the fun kind.
title: Send in the Clown - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
'Keep 'em in line... but get there on time!' Check out the Thank You Bus Driver announcement trailer for this upcoming chaotic bus driving game from Double Fine. In Thank you Bus Driver, you take on the role of a town’s bus driver just trying to get through the day with minimal rulebreaking and maximum gratitude… in the form of Thank Yous! 

Thank You Bus Driver will be available on PC (GOG, Humble Store, Itch.io, and Steam).
title: Thank You Bus Driver - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Console Launch Trailer for Dream Cage, a first-person psychological horror game developed by Hitori De Productions. Players will encounter five sleep paralysis demons over the course of five nights. Endure haunting anomalies and seek the truth behind the entity that haunts the mind in Dream Cage, available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Xbox Series X|S, alongside the game being available on PC (Steam).
title: Dream Cage - Official Console Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Announcement Trailer for Dysector, a first-person sci-fi repair-shop management shooter developed by Happenstance Games. Players will manage the day-to-day operations of a tech repair shop. Fix the devices from within to fight the corruption head-on and ensure the job's completion. Dysector is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Dysector - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Release Date Reveal Trailer for Ammossum, an action roguelike developed by West Glade. Players will take on hordes of enemies with an ever-upgrading weapon to take out the source of a lethal plague. Survive in Ammossum, launching on September 28 for PC (Steam).
title: Ammossum - Official Release Date Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Brigandine Abyss is available now on Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and Steam. Check out the Brigandine Abyss launch trailer for this new entry in the tactical strategy RPG series. In Brigandine Abyss, hundreds of years ago, the arcane Brigandine was used to thwart the ambitions of the Abyssloa Empire. Now, a new Abyssloa Empire rises from the ashes, ready to conquer the world. Confront the dark as you manage resources, rally your monsters, and stand against the empire in one of six different story campaigns.
title: Brigandine Abyss - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the ‘Honor Duel’ Season 24 Trailer for Rocket League, the hit vehicular football (soccer) game developed by Psyonix and Epic Games. Players can get a tease of the upcoming Honor Duel system in Season 24 of the game, where they can challenge other players to a friendly duel for glory and victory. The Honor Duel system is available now for Rocket League as part of Season 24.
title: Rocket League - Official ‘Honor Duel’ Season 24 Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's your look at The Grimm Reapress and the Drearytale Monster announcement trailer for the upcoming new storybook adventure game from the developers of The Liar Princess and the Blind Prince and The Cruel King and the Great Hero. Step into a hand-drawn fairytale, one book at a time in The Grimm Reapress and the Drearytale Monster. In this world, a magical disease known as Paper Mortis turns people into picture books, and picture books into monsters. The Grimm Reapress and the Drearytale Monster will be available on Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Steam.
title: The Grimm Reapress and the Drearytale Monster - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the Astonishia Story announcement trailer for this updated version of the classic Korean RPG, featuring enhanced visuals and refined mechanics. Astonishia Story will be available on Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and PC on February 11, 2027.

In Astonishia Story, follow Lloyd von Reuental on his quest to recover a stolen relic and regain his honor in this tale of prejudice, manipulation, and duty. The Elven Queen is set on claiming the powers of an ancient god, and it'll be up to you to stop her! Master grid-based battles, recruit mercenaries, and do whatever it takes to see your duty through, even if that means saving the world in the process.
title: Astonishia Story - Official Announcement and Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at gameplay and more from Gobble in this announcement trailer for the upcoming hand-painted 2D platforming adventure game. In Gobble, your family is missing, and it's up to you (and Scythariel!) to bring them home! Gobble will be available on Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and PC in 2027.
title: Gobble - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Iceblade of Narin Gameplay Trailer for Warframe, the hit action sci-fi co-op shooter developed by Digital Extremes. Players can get an extended look at combat from the first female ice-themed Warframe, Narin. Dish out ice-cold attacks and abilities as Narin, launching into Warframe on September 23 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, iOS, and Android.
title: Warframe - Official Iceblade of Narin Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Stranded Campaign First Look Teaser Trailer for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, the latest installment in the first-person action shooter franchise developed by Infinity Ward. Players can get a glimpse of the upcoming Stranded mission in the campaign. Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is launching on October 23 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (BattleNet, Steam, Xbox on PC).
title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 - Official Stranded Campaign First Look Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Join community lead Clemens Koch at Raw Power Games for a look at the exploration map in Chronicles: Medieval in this new video for the upcoming strategy action sandbox game set in the age of the Hundred Years' War. The new video showcases how you'll traverse across medieval Europe, places you can visit and discover, and a peek at adventures that await. Chronicles: Medieval will be available in Early Access on Steam in early 2027.

In Chronicles: Medieval, explore a brutal but beautiful, historically grounded Europe, command armies in massive battles, leave a mark the chroniclers can't ignore as you make your name one fight at a time. What story will you write?
title: Chronicles: Medieval - Official 'The Exploration Map' Video

author: GameTrailers
description: See what daily life is like in this latest Nivalis Nights trailer for the upcoming cyberpunk life sim game. In Nivalis Nights, grow your business, manage restaurants and nightclubs, make friends and enemies, buy and decorate apartments, go fishing and maybe even find love in Nivalis, the city that stretches from the ocean to the clouds. Nivalis Nights will be available on PC (Steam) on September 29, 2026.
title: Nivalis Nights - Official 'A Day In The Life' Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Console Release Date Trailer for Samson, a third-person action-adventure game developed by Liquid Swords. Players will take to the streets of Tyndalston as Samson, with his days numbered and a large debt to repay. Thrive in the criminal underworld and fight for freedom in Samson, launching on September 21 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Cloud, and Xbox on PC, with the game available now on PC (Steam).
title: Samson - Official Console Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Learn about the story of Stronghold 4 in this latest trailer for the upcoming narrative prequel to the original 'castle sim.' Wood needed! Return to the green roots of Stronghold in Stronghold 4. Immerse yourself in a cinematic campaign, hone your siegecraft with new mechanics in skirmish mode and customise your castles with a wide selection of castle pieces and cosmetics. Stronghold 4 will be available in PC Early Access in 2026. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: Stronghold 4 - Official Story Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Prove yourself as the Frontier’s greatest champion in The Trials of Remembrance. Learn what you can expect from Code Vein 2's The Trials of Remembrance Battle Rush Mode in this latest trailer for the action RPG. In the new Battle Rush Mode, replay your favorite foes and bosses from Code Vein II and even try your hand at new foes from the DLC Expansion. The Code Vein 2: Mask of Idris paid DLC expansion and the free update version 2.0 will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and Steam on September 9, 2026.
title: Code Vein 2 - Official Trials of Remembrance Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Worming from Home is available now on Steam. Watch the Worming from Home launch trailer for this remote work simulator where you are a worm. Be the Worm of Wall Street in this silly simulation game about working a remote finance job. Throw your spineless body around the keyboard to invest in the stock market and earn obscene amounts of money. Buy upgrades, train skills, and worm your way up to the promotion you've always dreamed of!
title: Worming from Home - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a deep dive into what to expect with the Mission Editor game mode for Ready or Not in this new trailer for the strategic tactical shooter game. The Mission Editor allows you to go "behind the scenes" for comprehensive tweaking of gameplay variables within a mission with a particular focus on customizing non-playable characters. Customizations will focus on tailoring the suspects, civilian, and SWAT specific modifiers for their behaviour, health, appearance, armaments, and more. Update version 1.5 of Ready or Not, which includes access to the Mission Editor, is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and Pc (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Ready or Not - Official Mission Editor Overview Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a closer look at the Dual Blades Boosted Action in this latest Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance trailer for the upcoming action RPG expansion. The new trailer spotlights the Dual Blades and breaks down their Boosted Action, featuring an unrelenting demonic barrage, pinpoint combo control, and increased melee range. Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance takes the hunt to new heights in Master Rank. New monsters and challenges, evolved hunting actions and mechanics, a new locale, and the next chapter in the Expedition Team's story await in Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance, available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and PC in 2027.
title: Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance - Official Dual Blades Boosted Action Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Become the Onimusha, Miyamoto Musashi, and prepare yourself for the intense duels that await. Get another look at formidable enemies, story, and combat from Onimusha: Way of the Sword in this launch trailer for the action game. Onimusha: Way of the Sword plunges the Oni Gauntlet wielding protagonist, Miyamoto Musashi into an early Edo-period Kyoto under siege by monstrous fiends known as Genma. Onimusha: Way of the Sword is available now on PC (Steam and Epic Game Store), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, Xbox on PC, and Nintendo Switch 2.
title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Announcement Trailer for Titan Sword, an upcoming third-person action-adventure game developed by Kadoy. Players will explore a battlefield to take on larger-than-life titans by way of a mighty and powerful sword. Scale titans and overcome challenges in Titan Sword, coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Titan Sword - Official Announcement Trailer
